long_biography.plain_text:
Dry-bulk shipping became the central business of Vasileios Zoulovits through Dalomar Shipping. He founded the privately held Athens company in 2006 after participating as an investor in Meadway Shipping & Trading. Dalomar developed as a boutique manager of Panamax, Supramax, Handymax, Handysize and minibulk tonnage, combining technical and commercial oversight with transactions in second-hand carriers.

Dalomar's fleet has expanded and contracted with freight-market cycles, while its management history covers 17 vessels. The business emphasizes safety, quality and environmental protection alongside global dry-cargo operations. Zoulovits has built the specialist platform through repeated vessel purchases, operational management and disposals. Dalomar's fleet history reflects long-horizon asset selection across changing dry-bulk markets.
